title: Hi, I'm Joe Schmitt
subtitle: I build things with my mind at [Compass](https://compass.com). Formerly, I made things [for humans](http://madeforhumans.com). Before that, at [Vimeo](http://vimeo.com) I helped [make iframes fun again](https://vimeo.com/blog/post:334), build an [HTML Video Player](http://developer.vimeo.com/player), and launch a [Music Store](http://vimeo.com/musicstore).
